scores.claim_text: ChargePoint operates a network of 100,000+ EV charging ports
scores.interpretation: NREL DOE registry shows 15,753 ChargePoint-named EV stations pre-cutoff. Network exists at substantial scale.

scores.claim_text: ChargePoint has external US public-co counterparty footprint

scores.interpretation: EPA FRS shows ChargePoint facility in Campbell, CA. Operations verified.

scores.claim_text: ChargePoint is NOT a vehicle manufacturer (sanity check — they make charging equipment)
scores.interpretation: NHTSA shows 0 ChargePoint manufacturer entries — exactly what's expected for a charging-equipment company that does not make vehicles. Framework correctly distinguishes.

scores.claim_text: ChargePoint has IP portfolio in EV charging hardware
